name: tasky
description: A visual task ledger for Claude Code: records prompts, delegated subagents and results through hooks at zero token cost, with a zero-token chat queue, opt-in queue draining, parallel headless workers and a local dashboard.

refresh_seconds.title: Board refresh (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often the terminal board asks tasky again between turns, so a background worker finishing shows up on the status line. 0 reads only at turn boundaries. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later.
